```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggbreak)
library(BSgenome)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

source('../CRISPR-KO-library-refinement-pipeline/sgRNA_library_refinement_pipeline_functions.R')
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")
```

# Import sgRNA library and sgRNA log-fold-change data

```{r}
avana_library_meyers <- read_tsv("../CRISPR-KO-library-refinement-pipeline/public_crispr_library/avana_library.tsv", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(avana_library_meyers) <- c("sgrna", "spacer", "gene")

avana_lfc <- read_csv("./sgrna_logfc/AvanaLogfoldChange.csv")
names(avana_lfc)[1] <- "spacer"

# left join
avana_sgrna_lfc <- avana_lfc %>%
  left_join(avana_library_meyers, join_by("spacer")) %>%
  relocate(sgrna, .before = spacer) %>%
  relocate(gene, .after = spacer) %>%
  arrange(gene)


terms <- c("CONTROL", "Control", "control", "INTRON", "Intron", "intron", "LacZ", "luciferase")
# lacZ and luciferase are the control in Toronto V3 library

terms_for_filtering <- paste(terms, collapse = "|")

annotation <- "../CRISPR-KO-library-refinement-pipeline/annotation_file/CCDS.20221027.txt"
genome_type_version <- "hg38"
bsgenome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

avana_alignment_meyers <- import_sgrna_library_alignment("../CRISPR-KO-library-refinement-pipeline/object_intermediate/hg38/avana_library_aln.csv", genome_type_version)

avana_classification <- off_target_classification(avana_alignment_meyers)

avana_stratify_multi_target <- off_target_alignment_bin(avana_classification[[1]], c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))

selected_df <- avana_stratify_multi_target[[1]] %>%
  select(sgRNA, alignment, alignment_bin) %>%
  dplyr::rename("sgrna" = "sgRNA")

avana_sgrna_lfc <- avana_sgrna_lfc %>%
  left_join(selected_df, join_by(sgrna)) %>%
  relocate(alignment, .after = gene) %>%
  relocate(alignment_bin, .after = alignment)



```
